alert-circle.context: Exclamation mark inside a circle. Used for error messages, form validation, alerts, attention notices and failed states in forms, toasts and banners.

alert-octagon.context: Exclamation mark inside an octagon, the shape of a stop sign. Used for critical errors, blocking failures, severe alerts, stop warnings and system outages.

badge-status.context: Rounded square with a solid dot on its top right corner. Used for unread badges, new item markers, notification dots on app icons and status indicators.

ban.context: Circle crossed by a diagonal bar. Used for banned or blocked users, forbidden actions, not-allowed cursors, disabled options and prohibition signs.

bell-ring.context: Bell with short ringing marks on both sides. Used for an active alert, alarm going off, notifications turned on, reminder due now and ring settings.

check-circle.context: Check mark inside a circle. Used for success messages, completed steps, verified items, confirmed orders, passed checks and done states in lists.

circle-check-dashed.context: Check mark inside a dashed circle. Used for pending approval, partially done tasks, optional steps, draft items and checks waiting to be confirmed.

circle-dashed.context: Circle drawn with a dashed outline and nothing inside. Used for not-started tasks, empty or draft states, backlog items, placeholders and unassigned slots.

circle-dot.context: Circle with a solid dot at its centre. Used for selected radio buttons, active states, recording, targets, current location and in-progress task status.

circle-half.context: Circle with one half filled solid. Used for half-complete progress, contrast and theme toggles, dark mode switches, partial states and 50 percent values.

close-circle.context: Diagonal cross inside a circle. Used for errors, failed states, clear buttons in search fields, cancel actions, removing tags and dismissing panels.

flag-status.context: Triangular pennant flying from a pole. Used for flagged items, follow-up markers, issue priority, reporting content, milestones and goals.

help.context: Question mark inside a circle. Used for help links, FAQs, support centres, tooltips that explain a field, onboarding tips and unknown states.

info.context: Lowercase letter i inside a circle. Used for information notices, details panels, tooltips, about pages, hints and neutral banners.

loader-circle.context: Circular arc that runs three quarters of the way round. Used as a loading spinner, busy indicator, pending request, refresh in progress and wait states.

plus-circle.context: Plus sign inside a circle. Used for add buttons, create new items, add to cart, expand sections, new entries in lists and floating action buttons.

progress-check.context: Check mark inside a ring that runs three quarters of the way round. Used for a step completed within a larger process, milestones, onboarding progress and partial completion.

shield-status.context: Shield with a pulse or heartbeat line across it. Used for system health, security status, protection monitoring, uptime checks and device safety scans.

status-away.context: Head and shoulders of a person with a crescent moon beside them. Used for away or idle presence, inactive users, sleep mode and quiet hours in chat apps.

status-busy.context: Head and shoulders of a person with a no-entry dot beside them. Used for busy or do not disturb presence, in a meeting status, focus time and muted notifications.

status-offline.context: Head and shoulders of a person with an empty ring beside them. Used for offline or invisible presence, unavailable users, logged-out contacts and disconnected accounts.

status-online.context: Head and shoulders of a person with a solid dot beside them. Used for online or available presence, active users, logged-in contacts and team member availability.

stop-sign.context: Octagonal road sign on a post with a horizontal bar across the middle. Used for stop warnings, halted processes, traffic and driving topics, road safety and end of route.

warning.context: Exclamation mark inside a triangle. Used for warnings, caution notices, risky actions, hazard signs, unsaved changes and alert banners.
